
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sri Chaitanya Schools – Revenue</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;}
body{background:#072B4F;}

.header-wrapper{
    background:#d9d9d9;
    margin:40px;
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:40px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    position:relative;
}
.logo-box{
    position:absolute;
    left:40px;
    background:#fff;
    padding:15px;
    border-radius:12px;
    box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}
.logo-box img{width:80px;}
.title-section{text-align:center;}
.main-title{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;}
.sub-title{margin-top:8px;font-size:16px;color:#555;}

.filter-section{
    background:#c7d0da;
    margin:0 40px 40px 40px;
    padding:25px;
    border-radius:20px;
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:20px;
    border:2px solid #f2c94c;
}
.filter-group{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
label{font-weight:600;font-size:16px;color:#072B4F;}
select{
    padding:8px 12px;
    border-radius:8px;
    border:2px solid #f2c94c;
    background:#f2f2f2;
    font-size:14px;
    outline:none;
}
.dashboard-container{
    margin:0 40px 40px 40px;
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:20px;
    padding:40px;
}
.cards-wrapper{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));
    gap:20px;
}
.card{
    background:#f7f9fc;
    padding:20px;
    border-radius:15px;
    text-align:center;
    box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
}
.card h3{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#072B4F;}
.card p{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;}
@media(max-width:768px){
    .header-wrapper{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;}
    .logo-box{position:static;margin-bottom:20px;}
    .filter-section{flex-direction:column;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="header-wrapper">
    <div class="logo-box">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Logo">
    </div>
    <div class="title-section">
        <div class="main-title">Sri Chaitanya Schools – Revenue</div>
        <div class="sub-title">Revenue Department</div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="filter-section">
    <div class="filter-group">
        <label>State</label>
        <select id="stateFilter">
            <option value="All">All States</option>
            <option>Andhra Pradesh</option>
            <option>Telangana</option>
            <option>Karnataka</option>
            <option>Tamilnadu</option>
            <option>West Bengal</option>
            <option>Assam</option>
            <option>CHHATTISGARH</option>
            <option>Gujarat</option>
            <option>Haryana</option>
            <option>Jharkhand</option>
            <option>Madhya Pradesh</option>
            <option>Maharastra</option>
            <option>NCR</option>
            <option>Odisha</option>
            <option>Punjab</option>
            <option>Rajasthan</option>
            <option>Uttar Pradesh</option>
            <option>Uttarakhand</option>
        </select>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-group">
        <label>Zone</label>
        <select id="zoneFilter"></select>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-group">
        <label>Branch</label>
        <select id="branchFilter"></select>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-group">
        <label>Academic Year</label>
        <select id="yearFilter">
            <option value="2026">2026–27</option>
            <option value="2025">2025–26</option>
            <option value="2024">2024–25</option>
        </select>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="dashboard-container">
    <div class="cards-wrapper">
        <div class="card"><h3>Total Students</h3><p id="students"></p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Total Revenue</h3><p id="revenue"></p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Paid Percentage</h3><p id="paid"></p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Balance Percentage</h3><p id="balance"></p></div>
        <div class="card"><h3>Zero Paid Students</h3><p id="zero"></p></div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
const structure = {
"Andhra Pradesh": ["Anantapur","Nellore","Kadapa","Kurnool","Guntur","Ongole","Vijayawada","Rajahmundry - West","Rajahmundry - East","Kakinada","Visakhapatnam","Tirupati"],
"Telangana": ["Mehdipatnam","Kompally","Ameerpet","Kukatpally","Dilsuknagar","Narayanguda","Hyderabad","Kodad"],
"Karnataka": ["Bengaluru"],
"Tamilnadu": ["Chennai"],
"West Bengal": ["Howrah"],
"Maharastra": ["Pune","Mumbai"],
"Rajasthan": ["Rajasthan"],
"Madhya Pradesh": ["Madhya Pradesh"],
"Assam": ["Assam"],
"CHHATTISGARH": ["CHHATTISGARH"],
"Gujarat": ["Gujarat"],
"Jharkhand": ["Jharkhand"],
"NCR": ["NCR"],
"Odisha": ["Odisha"],
"Punjab": ["Punjab"],
"Uttarakhand": ["Uttarakhand"],
"Uttar Pradesh": ["Uttar Pradesh"]
};

const years = ["2026","2025","2024"];
let data = [];

Object.keys(structure).forEach(state=>{
    structure[state].forEach(zone=>{
        years.forEach(year=>{
            data.push({
                state:state, zone:zone, branch:zone, year:year,
                students:Math.floor(Math.random()*1000+500),
                revenue:Math.floor(Math.random()*9000000+3000000),
                paid:Math.floor(Math.random()*20+60),
                zero:Math.floor(Math.random()*150+50)
            });
        });
    });
});

const stateFilter=document.getElementById("stateFilter");
const zoneFilter=document.getElementById("zoneFilter");
const branchFilter=document.getElementById("branchFilter");
const yearFilter=document.getElementById("yearFilter");

function loadZones(){
    const zones=data.filter(d=>stateFilter.value==="All"||d.state===stateFilter.value).map(d=>d.zone);
    const unique=[...new Set(zones)];
    zoneFilter.innerHTML="<option value='All'>All Zones</option>";
    unique.forEach(z=>zoneFilter.innerHTML+=`<option>${z}</option>`);
    loadBranches();
}

function loadBranches(){
    const branches=data.filter(d=>
        (stateFilter.value==="All"||d.state===stateFilter.value)&&
        (zoneFilter.value==="All"||d.zone===zoneFilter.value)
    ).map(d=>d.branch);
    const unique=[...new Set(branches)];
    branchFilter.innerHTML="<option value='All'>All Branches</option>";
    unique.forEach(b=>branchFilter.innerHTML+=`<option>${b}</option>`);
}

function updateDashboard(){
    const filtered=data.filter(d=>
        (stateFilter.value==="All"||d.state===stateFilter.value)&&
        (zoneFilter.value==="All"||d.zone===zoneFilter.value)&&
        (branchFilter.value==="All"||d.branch===branchFilter.value)&&
        d.year===yearFilter.value
    );
    if(filtered.length===0){
        document.getElementById("students").innerText="";
        document.getElementById("revenue").innerText="";
        document.getElementById("paid").innerText="";
        document.getElementById("balance").innerText="";
        document.getElementById("zero").innerText="";
        return;
    }
    const avgPaid=Math.round(filtered.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.paid,0)/filtered.length);
    document.getElementById("students").innerText=filtered.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.students,0).toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById("revenue").innerText="₹ "+filtered.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.revenue,0).toLocaleString();
    document.getElementById("paid").innerText=avgPaid+"%";
    document.getElementById("balance").innerText=(100-avgPaid)+"%";
    document.getElementById("zero").innerText=filtered.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.zero,0).toLocaleString();
}

stateFilter.addEventListener("change",()=>{loadZones();updateDashboard();});
zoneFilter.addEventListener("change",()=>{loadBranches();updateDashboard();});
branchFilter.addEventListener("change",updateDashboard);
yearFilter.addEventListener("change",updateDashboard);

loadZones();
</script>
</body>
</html>
